summary: Bundled `mhy-copy-input` clipboard helper (a self-contained webpack bundle with its own module runtime). Its default export `clipboard({ text, onSuccess, onFail })` creates a temporary read-only `input.mhy-copy-input` (font-size 14px) holding the text, selects it, runs `document.execCommand('copy')` (throwing when `queryCommandSupported('copy')` is false), removes the input and calls `onSuccess` or `onFail`; its `install(Vue)` method sets `Vue.prototype.$clipboard`.

exports.module.exports: the clipboard copy function (with install(Vue) registering $clipboard)
